docs.consent_letter_en:
[DATE]

To: [LANDLORD / PROPERTY MANAGER]
Re: Request for written consent to sublet [ADDRESS_1]

Dear [LANDLORD / PROPERTY MANAGER],

I am Alex Kim, a resident under the lease for [ADDRESS_1]. I request your express written consent to sublet the premises to Jordan Rivera from June 1, 2027 through July 28, 2027. The lease requires express written consent for a sublet and provides for a $150 administrative fee if approved (Lease, p. 3). Please confirm your approval in writing and advise how to pay the fee.

The proposed subtenant’s rent is $1,950 per month. The proposed security deposit is $1,500, to be held through Rentrail escrow, subject to confirmation that the holding arrangement meets Connecticut security-deposit requirements. Alex Kim will remain responsible for obligations under the master lease through its original term, including damage caused by the subtenant, as stated in the lease (p. 3). This request does not seek to change the master lease or release any resident from liability.

Please also confirm any required screening, documents, insurance proof, or move-in procedures for Jordan Rivera. The lease requires at least $100,000 per-occurrence personal liability coverage and proof before move-in (p. 2). Please confirm whether the subtenant must provide separate proof or may be covered under an existing compliant policy.

The master lease states that its initial term ends July 31, 2027 and then renews month-to-month unless either side gives at least 60 days’ written notice (p. 1); it also requires at least 60 days’ written move-out notice (p. 3). Please confirm that this sublet approval does not alter those provisions.

Please sign below to provide written consent, subject to any conditions stated here.

Sincerely,

Alex Kim

Landlord’s written consent: ______________________________
Name/title: ______________________________  Date: __________________
Conditions (if any): __________________________________________________
docs.agreement_md_en:
# SUBLEASE AGREEMENT — DRAFT

**Do not sign or allow occupancy until the landlord’s express written consent is received.** The master lease requires written consent and a $150 administrative fee if approved (Lease, p. 3). Fill in all bracketed items and confirm the deposit-holding arrangements and utility allocation before signing.

## 1. Parties and premises
- **Sublessor (original tenant):** Alex Kim
- **Subtenant:** Jordan Rivera
- **Premises:** [ADDRESS_1] (unit: [UNIT])
- **Master landlord/property manager:** [LANDLORD / PROPERTY MANAGER]

## 2. Term
The sublease begins **June 1, 2027** and ends **July 28, 2027**. It does not extend the master lease or grant a right to remain afterward. The master lease’s stated initial term ends July 31, 2027 and automatically renews month-to-month unless either side gives at least 60 days’ written notice (Lease, p. 1). The sublessor remains responsible for complying with the master lease, including its 60-day written move-out notice requirement (Lease, p. 3). The subtenant must vacate by the sublease end date unless all necessary parties agree otherwise in writing.

## 3. Rent and payment
Rent is **$1,950 per month**. Payment due date, payment method, and any first/last-period proration must be completed in writing before signing: **[DUE DATE / PAYMENT METHOD / PRORATION AGREEMENT]**. Do not assume the master lease’s $2,150 rent is the subtenant’s rent; the subtenant’s agreed rent is the amount above. The sublessor remains responsible to the master landlord for the master-lease rent, due on or before the 1st through the resident portal (Lease, p. 1). The master lease states a $50 initial late charge if all rent is not paid by the 10th (p. 1); this does not authorize an unlisted sublease fee.

## 4. Security deposit and escrow
The subtenant will pay a **$1,500 security deposit** to **Rentrail escrow**, to be held until the return inspection. Before accepting funds, the parties must confirm in writing that the escrow arrangement complies with Connecticut requirements for a sublessor acting as a landlord, including deposit in an escrow account at a Connecticut financial institution. The account/institution details and written notice of the amount held must be provided as required by law.

The deposit is not rent. Any claim must be limited to lawful, supportable amounts, with an itemized written statement. The sublessor will return the balance and applicable accrued interest by the legal deadline. The stated target date is **August 18, 2027**, based on termination on July 28, 2027; if the subtenant gives the forwarding address later, the statutory deadline may be later (15 days after receipt of the written address or 21 days after termination, whichever is later). No deduction may be made for pre-existing conditions or ordinary wear and tear. The parties will provide Rentrail the inspection records and any written agreement on a disputed claim; escrow release must follow the applicable legal process and Rentrail’s documented procedures.

## 5. Utilities and services
- **Electricity:** Subtenant is responsible for electricity during the sublease, as agreed by the parties. The master lease requires the tenant to pay the electric utility directly (Lease, p. 2 and p. 4). Record the account-transfer or reimbursement method here: **[METHOD / ACCOUNT ARRANGEMENT]**.
- **Water, sewer, and trash:** The master lease bills these through Conservice, allocated by occupants and square footage, with a $3.95 monthly service/administrative fee; a final bill may be estimated (Lease, p. 4). The facts do not specify whether the subtenant reimburses any part. Before signing, choose and state the arrangement: **[SUBTENANT SHARE / HOW CALCULATED / BILLING AND PAYMENT DATE, OR “SUBLESSOR PAYS; NO REIMBURSEMENT”]**.
- **Heat and hot water:** The master lease says these are provided by the landlord, but the Lease Card does not identify who pays for them (Lease, p. 4). Confirm any charge, if applicable: **[CONFIRMATION / ALLOCATION]**.
- **Internet and cable:** These are the tenant’s responsibility under the master lease (Lease, p. 4). State the parties’ arrangement: **[WHO PAYS / SERVICE / REIMBURSEMENT, IF ANY]**.

No utility charge may be passed through without an agreed, understandable allocation and supporting bill or calculation.

## 6. Master-lease rules and responsibilities
The subtenant agrees to follow the applicable master-lease terms and property rules supplied with this agreement. If this agreement conflicts with the master lease or landlord’s written consent, the master lease and consent control; this sublease cannot give the subtenant greater rights than the sublessor has. The sublessor remains liable under the master lease through its original term, including for subtenant-caused damage (Lease, p. 3).

Key rules carried down include:
- Keep the premises clean and safe; use fixtures, appliances, and building systems reasonably (Lease, p. 2; CT-47a-11).
- Submit non-emergency repair requests through the online resident portal or as a signed written request delivered to the office; emergency maintenance is available 24 hours (Lease, p. 2).
- Maintain required personal liability insurance of at least **$100,000 per occurrence** and provide proof before move-in, subject to landlord confirmation of the subtenant’s required coverage (Lease, p. 2).
- The lease lists two apartment keys and one mailbox key; all must be returned. It states a $75 rekeying charge for each unreturned key (Lease, p. 1).
- Follow any additional written rules attached here: **[ATTACH MASTER-LEASE RULES / ADDENDA]**.

## 7. Hand-off and condition record
At hand-off, the parties will jointly inspect and document the unit, keys, meter/account information, and existing defects. The master lease requires an inventory form within 48 hours after move-in (Lease, p. 2). The subtenant should send the completed condition record and dated photos to the sublessor within that 48-hour period so the sublessor can meet the lease requirement. Attach the hand-off checklist and photos: **[ATTACHMENT / EVIDENCE LOCATION]**.

## 8. Return inspection and deposit decisions
The parties will schedule a joint return inspection on or near July 28, 2027. The subtenant may attend. The subtenant will remove personal property, leave the premises clean, and return all keys and access devices, consistent with the master lease’s move-out procedure (Lease, p. 3). Record the condition with dated photos and compare them with the hand-off record.

A proposed deduction must identify the specific new damage or unpaid amount, show its connection to the subtenant, and include a reasonable amount and supporting documentation. No charge will be made for pre-existing conditions or ordinary wear. Unpaid rent or utilities may be considered only if actually due and documented. A carpet-cleaning term in the master lease (p. 3) does not make a charge automatic under this sublease; any deduction must be lawful and supported. The sublessor will provide the required itemized written statement and return any undisputed balance and applicable interest by the legal deadline.

## 9. Notices and signatures
Notices between the parties must be in writing and delivered to:
- Sublessor: **[ADDRESS / EMAIL]**
- Subtenant: **[FORWARDING ADDRESS / EMAIL]**

The subtenant must give the sublessor a written forwarding address at move-out. This agreement becomes effective only after the landlord’s written consent is attached.

**Sublessor:** Alex Kim  Signature: __________________  Date: __________

**Subtenant:** Jordan Rivera  Signature: __________________  Date: __________

**Landlord’s written consent attached:** ☐ Yes  ☐ No

**Attachments:** landlord consent; master lease and applicable addenda/rules; hand-off inventory and photos; utility allocation; insurance proof; escrow/institution notice.

sublessor_duties.en: Obtain the landlord’s express written consent before the sublet; the lease also states a $150 approval fee (Lease, p. 3). Keep written proof of consent and fee payment.

sublessor_duties.en: As a tenant who sublets, you are treated as a landlord for security-deposit purposes. Ensure the deposit is held in a qualifying Connecticut financial institution escrow account, provide the required account notice, and pay applicable interest. Confirm that Rentrail escrow meets these requirements before collecting the deposit.
sublessor_duties.ko: 전대하는 세입자는 보증금 관련 법에서 임대인으로 취급됩니다. 보증금이 요건에 맞는 코네티컷 금융기관 에스크로 계좌에 보관되는지, 계좌 안내와 이자가 적절히 제공되는지 확인하세요. Rentrail 에스크로가 요건을 충족하는지 보증금을 받기 전에 확인해야 합니다.

sublessor_duties.en: Return the deposit balance and applicable interest with a written itemized statement by the statutory deadline: 21 days after termination or 15 days after receiving the written forwarding address, whichever is later. August 18, 2027 is the 21-day date after July 28, but a later address may change the deadline.
sublessor_duties.ko: 보증금 잔액과 해당 이자를 항목별 서면 명세와 함께 법정 기한 내 반환하세요. 종료 후 21일 또는 서면 새 주소를 받은 후 15일 중 더 늦은 날까지입니다. 2027년 8월 18일은 7월 28일 종료 기준 21일째이지만, 주소를 더 늦게 받으면 기한이 달라질 수 있습니다.

sublessor_duties.en: Give the subtenant written notice within 30 days after receiving the deposit stating the amount held and the financial institution’s name and address; confirm the deposit is placed in escrow immediately.
sublessor_duties.ko: 보증금을 받은 뒤 즉시 에스크로에 예치하고, 30일 이내에 보관액과 금융기관의 이름·주소를 서면으로 안내하세요.

sublessor_duties.en: Pay the applicable accrued deposit interest. The law pack gives a 2026 rate only; the applicable 2027 rate must be checked rather than assumed.
sublessor_duties.ko: 적용되는 보증금 이자를 지급하세요. 제공된 자료에는 2026년 이율만 있으므로 2027년 이율은 별도로 확인해야 합니다.

subtenant_checklist.en: Before moving in, get the landlord’s written consent and a copy of the applicable master-lease rules and addenda. Do not rely on verbal approval.
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 전 집주인의 서면 동의와 적용되는 원계약 규칙·추가약정 사본을 받으세요. 구두 승인은 믿지 마세요.

subtenant_checklist.en: Within 48 hours after move-in, document defects, damage, pests, and safety concerns with the inventory form and dated photos; send copies to the sublessor promptly (Lease, p. 2).
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 후 48시간 이내에 재고·상태 양식과 날짜가 있는 사진으로 하자, 손상, 해충, 안전 문제를 기록하고 전대인에게 사본을 보내세요(2쪽).

subtenant_checklist.en: Get written confirmation of rent due dates, payment method, any proration, and exactly how water, sewer, trash, heat, hot water, internet, and cable are allocated. Only electricity is identified as the subtenant’s responsibility in the supplied facts.
subtenant_checklist.ko: 임대료 납부일·방법·일할 계산 여부와 수도·하수·쓰레기·난방·온수·인터넷·케이블 분담 방식을 서면으로 확인하세요. 제공된 사실에서 전차인 부담으로 정해진 공과금은 전기뿐입니다.

subtenant_checklist.en: Obtain written escrow details, confirmation of a qualifying Connecticut financial-institution account, the amount held, and the institution’s name and address. Give a forwarding address in writing at move-out.
subtenant_checklist.ko: 요건에 맞는 코네티컷 금융기관 계좌인지 확인하고, 보관액·금융기관 이름과 주소를 서면으로 받으세요. 퇴거할 때 새 주소도 서면으로 제공하세요.

subtenant_checklist.en: Keep the hand-off and return inspection records. Ask for an itemized written explanation and supporting amounts for any proposed deduction; the sublessor must meet the statutory return deadline.
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 인수와 퇴거 점검 자료를 보관하세요. 공제 제안이 있으면 항목별 서면 설명과 금액 근거를 요청하세요. 전대인은 법정 반환 기한을 지켜야 합니다.

subtenant_checklist.en: Confirm insurance requirements with the landlord before move-in. The master lease requires at least $100,000 per-occurrence liability coverage and proof before move-in (Lease, p. 2).
subtenant_checklist.ko: 입주 전에 보험 요건을 집주인에게 확인하세요. 원계약은 사고당 최소 10만 달러 책임보험과 입주 전 증빙을 요구합니다(2쪽).

risks.en: The lease requires express written consent. Occupying before approval may breach the master lease; obtain consent and clarify the $150 administrative fee first (Lease, p. 3).
risks.ko: 원계약은 명시적 서면 동의를 요구합니다. 승인 전 입주하면 원계약 위반이 될 수 있으므로 먼저 동의와 150달러 수수료를 확인하세요(3쪽).

risks.en: The sublessor remains liable through the master lease’s original term, including subtenant-caused damage. The master lease ends July 31, 2027, three days after this proposed sublease ends (Lease, p. 1 and p. 3).
risks.ko: 전대인은 전차인으로 인한 손해를 포함해 원계약상 책임을 계속 집니다. 전대 기간 종료일은 2027년 7월 28일이고 원계약은 7월 31일까지여서 3일 차이가 있습니다(1쪽, 3쪽).

risks.en: The master lease auto-renews month-to-month unless 60 days’ written notice is given and requires 60 days’ written move-out notice (Lease, p. 1 and p. 3). The supplied facts do not show whether notice was given; check immediately to avoid an unintended renewal or continuing rent liability.
risks.ko: 원계약은 60일 전 서면 통지가 없으면 월 단위로 자동 갱신되고, 퇴거에도 60일 전 서면 통지가 필요합니다(1쪽, 3쪽). 통지 여부가 제공되지 않았으므로 원치 않는 갱신이나 추가 임대료 책임을 피하려면 즉시 확인하세요.

risks.en: Rentrail escrow may not by itself satisfy the statutory requirement to place deposits in escrow at a Connecticut financial institution. Verify the actual account and compliance before taking the $1,500 deposit.
risks.ko: Rentrail 에스크로라는 사실만으로 코네티컷 금융기관 예치 요건을 충족한다고 단정할 수 없습니다. 1,500달러를 받기 전에 실제 계좌와 준수 여부를 확인하세요.

risks.en: The stated August 18, 2027 return date assumes the tenancy ends July 28 and no later forwarding-address date controls. The statutory rule uses whichever is later: 21 days after termination or 15 days after written forwarding-address notice.
risks.ko: 2027년 8월 18일은 7월 28일 종료를 기준으로 한 날짜이며, 더 늦게 전달된 새 주소가 기한을 바꾸지 않는다는 전제입니다. 법정 기한은 종료 후 21일과 서면 주소 통지 후 15일 중 더 늦은 날입니다.

risks.en: Utility responsibility is incomplete: only electricity is assigned to the subtenant. Write down who pays the Conservice charges and internet/cable, how shared charges are calculated, and any heat/hot-water charges before signing (Lease, p. 4).
risks.ko: 공과금 분담이 완전히 정해지지 않았습니다. 전기만 전차인 부담으로 지정되어 있습니다. 서명 전에 Conservice 요금, 인터넷·케이블 및 난방·온수 비용의 부담자와 분담 계산법을 적으세요(4쪽).

risks.en: The $1,500 deposit, payment due dates, first/last-period proration, and utility reimbursement terms need a clear written arrangement. The applicable 2027 deposit-interest rate also needs checking; do not assume the 2026 rate.
risks.ko: 1,500달러 보증금, 임대료 납부일, 첫·마지막 기간의 일할 계산, 공과금 정산 방식을 서면으로 명확히 해야 합니다. 적용되는 2027년 보증금 이율도 확인해야 하며 2026년 이율을 그대로 적용하면 안 됩니다.

docs.summary_ko: 집주인의 서면 동의를 받기 전에는 전대를 시작하지 마세요. 계약상 150달러 행정 수수료가 있고, 전대인 [PERSON_1]은 원계약 책임을 계속 집니다. 특히 Rentrail 에스크로가 코네티컷 금융기관 예치 요건을 충족하는지 확인해야 합니다. 전기 외 공과금 분담, 임대료 납부일·일할 계산, 보험, 보증금 이자율과 반환 절차를 서면으로 확정하세요. 2027년 7월 28일 종료 기준 21일은 8월 18일이지만, 새 주소를 나중에 받으면 법정 반환 기한이 더 늦어질 수 있습니다.

pending_items.note_en: The comparison supports new damage: the area appears clean in Exhibit E20 (hand-off inspection; date not provided) and a crack appears in Exhibit E30 (move-out inspection; date not provided). The $150 is only a provisional estimate, not a verified repair price, so keep up to $150 in escrow pending an invoice or quote; do not treat it as an approved deduction yet. Lease p.1; CT-47a-21-d2; CT-47a-21-j2.
pending_items.note_ko: Exhibit E20(인계 점검, 자료에 날짜 없음)에서는 해당 부위가 깨끗해 보이고 Exhibit E30(퇴거 점검, 자료에 날짜 없음)에서는 균열이 보여 새 손상으로 판단됩니다. 다만 $150은 확인된 수리비가 아닌 잠정 추정액이므로, 견적서나 영수증을 받을 때까지 최대 $150을 에스크로에 보류하고 지금은 공제액으로 승인하지 않습니다. 계약서 1쪽; CT-47a-21-d2; CT-47a-21-j2.

comparison.summary_ko: 거실 바닥의 패임과 복도 벽의 찍힘은 인계 당시 이미 기록되어 있었습니다. 침실 벽의 균열은 이전 침실 영상과 비교해 새로 생긴 것으로 보입니다.

items.item: Bedroom wall crack repair (provisional; confirm with an invoice)
items.reason_en: The hand-off area appears clean in Exhibit E20, while Exhibit E30 shows a crack at the corresponding spot. Claim only the reasonable actual repair cost; $150 is a cautious provisional estimate, not a verified quote. Keep any amount claimed in escrow until priced, and provide written itemization. Do not deduct for the pre-existing living-room gouge or hallway chip.
items.reason_ko: 인계 당시 Exhibit E20의 해당 벽면은 깨끗해 보이고, Exhibit E30에는 같은 위치에 균열이 보입니다. 실제로 발생한 합리적인 수리비만 청구하세요. $150은 확인된 견적이 아니라 신중한 잠정 추정액입니다. 견적이 나올 때까지 청구액은 에스크로에 두고 서면으로 항목별 내역을 제공하세요. 기존 거실 바닥 흠집이나 복도 벽 칩은 공제하지 마세요.

items.reason_en: The computed subtenant share is $88.10 and is unpaid. The lease permits deductions for unpaid utility shares; verify the bill was shared through Rentrail and include the utility amount in the written itemization. Bill 4 is referenced in the supplied facts, but no Rentrail evidence ID was provided.
items.reason_ko: 계산된 전기요금 분담액 $88.10이 미납 상태입니다. 계약은 미납 공과금 분담액의 공제를 허용합니다. Rentrail을 통해 청구서가 공유되었는지 확인하고 서면 공제 내역에 금액을 기재하세요. 제공된 사실에는 청구서 4번이 언급됐지만 Rentrail 증거 ID는 없습니다.

claim.summary_en: Proposed claims total $238.10, of the $1,500 escrow deposit, subject to confirming the repair cost and bill-sharing record. The return deadline is 21 days after the July 28 termination (August 18, 2027), unless a later forwarding-address notice changes the statutory deadline. Return the remaining deposit plus accrued interest with a written itemized statement. The living-room gouge and hallway chip are pre-existing and should not be charged.
claim.summary_ko: 제안한 청구액은 총 $238.10이며, 수리비와 청구서 공유 기록 확인이 전제입니다. $1,500 에스크로 보증금 중 해당 금액을 청구하는 안입니다. 법정 반환 기한은 7월 28일 종료일로부터 21일 후인 2027년 8월 18일입니다. 다만 더 늦은 주소 통지를 받으면 법정 기한이 달라질 수 있습니다. 남은 보증금과 발생 이자를 서면 항목별 내역과 함께 반환하세요. 거실 바닥 흠집과 복도 벽 칩은 기존 손상이므로 공제하면 안 됩니다.

items.note_en: The comparison supports new damage: the area appears clean in Exhibit E20 (hand-off inspection; date not provided) and a crack appears in Exhibit E30 (move-out inspection; date not provided). The $150 is only a provisional estimate, not a verified repair price, so keep up to $150 in escrow pending an invoice or quote; do not treat it as an approved deduction yet. Lease p.1; CT-47a-21-d2; CT-47a-21-j2.
items.note_ko: Exhibit E20(인계 점검, 자료에 날짜 없음)에서는 해당 부위가 깨끗해 보이고 Exhibit E30(퇴거 점검, 자료에 날짜 없음)에서는 균열이 보여 새 손상으로 판단됩니다. 다만 $150은 확인된 수리비가 아닌 잠정 추정액이므로, 견적서나 영수증을 받을 때까지 최대 $150을 에스크로에 보류하고 지금은 공제액으로 승인하지 않습니다. 계약서 1쪽; CT-47a-21-d2; CT-47a-21-j2.

items.note_en: Approve the computed unpaid June 1–30, 2027 electricity share of $88.10 (bill 4, Shoreline Electric, due July 16, 2027). The sublease assigns electricity to the subtenant and provides for reimbursement of the term share (lease p.2); the supplied facts identify it as unpaid. Include it in the written itemization. CT-47a-21-a14; CT-47a-21-d2; DOB-itemize.
items.note_ko: 2027년 6월 1~30일 전기요금 분담 미납액 $88.10을 승인합니다(Shoreline Electric 청구서 4, 납기 2027년 7월 16일). 계약서 2쪽은 전기요금을 전대차인 부담으로 정하고 해당 기간의 분담금 상환을 규정하며, 제공된 사실상 미납입니다. 서면 항목별 내역에 포함하세요. CT-47a-21-a14; CT-47a-21-d2; DOB-itemize.

ruling.ruling_en: The evidence comparison supports that the bedroom wall crack is new, but $150 is not a verified repair cost, so it may remain in escrow pending an invoice or quote and is not approved as a deduction now. The computed unpaid electricity share of $88.10 is approved under the sublease terms. Release $1,261.90 of the $1,500 deposit now, plus accrued interest, and provide an itemized statement; keep up to $150 in escrow pending pricing. The return deadline is August 18, 2027, unless a later forwarding-address notice changes it (CT-47a-21-d2).
ruling.ruling_ko: 증거 비교상 침실 벽 균열은 새 손상으로 보이지만, $150은 확인된 수리비가 아니므로 지금 공제액으로 승인하지 않고 견적서나 영수증을 받을 때까지 에스크로에 보류할 수 있습니다. 계약 조건에 따라 미납 전기요금 분담액 $88.10은 승인합니다. 보증금 $1,500 중 $1,261.90과 발생 이자를 지금 반환하고 항목별 내역을 제공하며, 수리비 산정 전까지 최대 $150을 보류하세요. 이후 주소 통지가 기한을 변경하지 않는 한 반환 기한은 2027년 8월 18일입니다(CT-47a-21-d2).
ruling.letter_en:
To [PERSON_1] and [PERSON_2],

This is Rentrail’s proposed settlement accounting for the $1,500 escrow deposit. The sublease permits deductions for unpaid utility shares and reasonable repair costs for damage beyond normal wear and tear, and requires an itemized statement (lease p.1). The electricity share for June 1–30, 2027 is $88.10 and is unpaid; the sublease assigns electricity reimbursement to the subtenant (lease p.2). We approve that amount as “Utility share: Electricity.”

The bedroom wall comparison supports new damage: Exhibit E20, hand-off inspection (date not provided in the materials), appears clean at the relevant spot, while Exhibit E30, move-out inspection (date not provided in the materials), shows a crack. The $150 repair figure is provisional, not a verified quote. Keep up to $150 in escrow pending an invoice or quote and do not finalize a repair deduction until the actual reasonable cost is documented. The pre-existing living-room gouge and hallway chip are not included as deductions.

Please release $1,261.90 from escrow to [PERSON_2] now, plus accrued interest, and provide a written itemized statement. Keep up to $150 in escrow for the wall repair pending pricing. The agreement provides for return within 21 days after the sublease ends, and CT-47a-21-d2 requires return of the balance and interest with an itemized statement by the applicable deadline; CT-47a-21-j2 defines a good-faith claim by reference to written notice. The stated deadline is August 18, 2027, unless a later forwarding-address notice changes it. Please confirm the accounting and arrange the release within 10 days of receiving this notice.

Regards,
[PERSON_2]
ruling.letter_ko_summary: [PERSON_1]님과 [PERSON_2]님께: 보증금 $1,500 중 미납 전기요금 분담액 $88.10을 공제하고, 침실 벽 균열의 수리비는 견적서나 영수증을 받을 때까지 최대 $150을 에스크로에 보류하는 정산안을 안내합니다. Exhibit E20(인계 점검)과 Exhibit E30(퇴거 점검)의 비교는 새 균열을 뒷받침하지만, 자료에 점검 날짜가 없고 $150은 확인된 견적이 아니므로 실제 합리적 수리비가 확인되기 전에는 공제액으로 확정하지 않습니다. 거실 흠집과 복도 칩은 기존 손상이므로 청구하지 않습니다. [PERSON_2]에게 $1,261.90과 발생 이자를 지금 반환하고 항목별 내역을 제공해 주세요. 해당 수리비 보류 및 반환 기한을 포함한 정산에 10일 이내 회신해 주세요.
